entries.name: Qiskit MCP Server
entries.upstream: Upstream MCP for circuit construction, transpilation and QASM/QPY export
entries.reuse: Preserve upstream schemas, circuit references and serialization.
entries.build: Add a supported tool profile and bind circuit IDs and inputs to experiment manifests.
entries.test: Discover the tools in a fresh workspace, create and transpile a Bell circuit, export it, and compare with direct SDK usage. Check bad input and unsupported instructions.

entries.name: Qiskit SDK
entries.upstream: QuantumCircuit, transpiler, Statevector and result schemas
entries.reuse: Use the SDK for the direct reference calculation and compiled-circuit validation.
entries.build: Pin SDK, target, seeds and classical-register decoding.
entries.test: Check analytic Bell probabilities, circuit equivalence up to global phase where applicable and preservation of register order.

entries.name: Qiskit Aer
entries.upstream: AerSimulator for ideal, noisy and selected GPU simulation modes
entries.reuse: Reuse native simulation methods, noise models and backend metadata.
entries.build: Expose a narrow executor with recorded method, seed, shots and limits, and route its results back to the circuit record.
entries.test: Compare exact ideal probabilities and seeded counts across direct and MCP runs. Run a separate noise-model fixture and verify its expected effect.

entries.name: Qiskit IBM Runtime MCP
entries.upstream: Upstream MCP with hardware discovery, primitives and jobs
entries.reuse: Reuse published discovery, job and primitive contracts where access exists.
entries.build: Preserve device, service job ID, primitive, limits and whether execution used a physical QPU.
entries.test: Prove the local-testing path first. Later verify an authorized Bell run, native metadata and statistical checks with capped shots.

entries.name: Qiskit IBM Transpiler MCP
entries.upstream: Upstream transpiler service MCP
entries.reuse: Reuse supported compilation when an authorized case needs it.
entries.build: Record source/compiled hashes, backend target and circuit depth and two-qubit gate counts.
entries.test: Compile the same fixture locally and through the service. Check target compatibility, numerical equivalence and unsupported-target errors.

entries.name: Qiskit Docs MCP
entries.upstream: Read-only documentation MCP
entries.reuse: Use original API and tutorial retrieval.
entries.build: Retain source URL and SDK version relevant to a run; keep retrieval separate from execution evidence.
entries.test: Resolve a known API query to the correct version and record failure when a historical version cannot be found.

entries.name: Qiskit Gym MCP
entries.upstream: Community MCP for learning-based synthesis and routing
entries.reuse: Reuse its supported environments and fixtures.
entries.build: Map an admitted synthesis goal and separate circuit artifacts from generated policies.
entries.test: Replay a small benchmark; compare equivalence and circuit cost against a conventional compiler on the same target.

entries.name: Qiskit Optimization Mapper
entries.upstream: QUBO/Ising converters for supported formulations
entries.reuse: Use published binary problem conversion and Hamiltonian tools.
entries.build: Record mapping from site and coverage variables to bits, auxiliary variables, penalty and decoding.
entries.test: Compare every feasible small assignment against a direct original-objective evaluator; include failed cardinality and overlap fixtures.

entries.name: QAOA with Qiskit
entries.upstream: QAOA ansatz, classical optimizer and sampler
entries.reuse: Reuse existing algorithm blocks and the configured sampler.
entries.build: Implement the bounded Helsinki experiment, explicit seeds and independent feasibility and score validation.
entries.test: Compare fixed-seed runs to the exact optimum. Report objective gap, feasible and optimal sampling rates, shots and full time.

entries.name: Classical exact enumeration
entries.upstream: Python combinations and exact scoring of the original objective
entries.reuse: Use the standard library and a versioned distance matrix.
entries.build: Create the independent oracle with ties and set-union coverage.
entries.test: Verify all 28 choices for two sites out of eight, with fixtures for ties, unreachable schools and no double counting.

entries.name: OR-Tools CP-SAT
entries.upstream: Integer and Boolean constraints, status and bounds
entries.reuse: Use CP-SAT to scale the classical comparator.
entries.build: Model the same coverage and preserve solver bounds, time limits and status.
entries.test: Match exhaustive results on small cases and report feasible versus proved optimal on a larger case.

entries.name: HiGHS
entries.upstream: LP/MIP solver
entries.reuse: Use the native integer solver as a second comparator.
entries.build: Encode the same scoring problem and preserve tolerance and bound metadata.
entries.test: Compare exact objectives and admissible ties with enumeration and CP-SAT.

entries.name: QOBLIB
entries.upstream: Published benchmark instances and comparison evidence
entries.reuse: Select versioned instances and review their individual reuse terms.
entries.build: Map fixture identity, known bounds and solver settings to run records.
entries.test: Reproduce a supported small instance and label observed and published metrics separately.

entries.name: Urban MCP walking accessibility
entries.upstream: Existing OSMnx case, licensed snapshots and rules
entries.reuse: Reuse the Helsinki network, mapped school IDs, snap rules and provenance.
entries.build: Compute a new school-to-candidate matrix with eight documented hypothetical sites.
entries.test: Compare routes and matrix orientation with native OSMnx; verify unreachable values, threshold behavior, coverage IDs and attribution.

entries.name: OLDT Canvas
entries.upstream: Versioned studies and scenario results
entries.reuse: Reuse supported import and revision contracts.
entries.build: Convert validated placements to inspectable GeoJSON bound to an alternative.
entries.test: Open the result in a test Twin and verify site identities, geometry, revision and separation from the baseline.

entries.name: Google Cirq
entries.upstream: Cirq circuits, simulator and devices
entries.reuse: Reuse the native SDK and device constraints.
entries.build: Map compatible circuits and retain measurement keys and qubit order.
entries.test: Compare ideal probabilities for equivalent circuits and reject unsupported gates explicitly.

entries.name: Google qsim
entries.upstream: Cirq-compatible state-vector simulator
entries.reuse: Reuse native CPU and supported GPU simulation.
entries.build: Expose a profile only for a measurable supported workload.
entries.test: Compare probabilities with Cirq and record time and memory as qubits or circuit counts grow.

entries.name: PennyLane
entries.upstream: QNodes, devices and hybrid differentiation
entries.reuse: Use QNodes and a supported device and gradient method.
entries.build: Register a bounded variational experiment with versioned configuration.
entries.test: Check one expectation and gradient against analytic or finite-difference results, then compare direct and MCP paths.

entries.name: PennyLane Lightning
entries.upstream: CPU, GPU and tensor simulator devices; supported MPI modes
entries.reuse: Use existing device plugins and simulation options.
entries.build: Bind device, precision, mode and resource limits to the local GPU or HPC job.
entries.test: Compare CPU results with a permitted GPU or MPI path and record precision and any approximation.

entries.name: NVIDIA CUDA-Q
entries.upstream: Circuit kernels and simulation and physical targets
entries.reuse: Use native target selection, libraries and measured results.
entries.build: Add a recipe dispatchable to local GPU or HPC with precisely identified backend and parallel settings.
entries.test: Compare Bell and parameterized fixtures across supported CPU/GPU paths before testing authorized distributed execution.

entries.name: NVIDIA cuQuantum
entries.upstream: cuStateVec and cuTensorNet
entries.reuse: Reuse the dependency supported by the selected simulator.
entries.build: Record library, method, version and compatible resources in the parent recipe.
entries.test: Verify that the parent simulator identifies its mode and agrees with a known CPU reference within tolerance.

entries.name: QuTiP
entries.upstream: Quantum dynamics and open-system solvers
entries.reuse: Use the native solvers for an admitted dynamics or noise reference.
entries.build: Add a bounded recipe for Hamiltonian, time and observables.
entries.test: Compare a two-level system to the analytic result and preserve time and measurement units.

entries.name: pytket
entries.upstream: Compiler and target extensions
entries.reuse: Use native compiler passes and the chosen provider extension.
entries.build: Preserve target and settings, layout, source and result circuit hashes.
entries.test: Check ideal equivalence for a fixture and target-specific errors for unsupported gates.

entries.name: Amazon Braket
entries.upstream: SDK, managed simulators, devices and Hybrid Jobs
entries.reuse: Reuse provider APIs and native device and job metadata.
entries.build: Bind backend and job type, lifecycle, S3 result references and reported resource consumption.
entries.test: Use an authorized simulator fixture, verify native artifacts and status, then require a capped physical fixture for QPU support.

entries.name: Azure Quantum
entries.upstream: Workspace targets and native job APIs
entries.reuse: Reuse an approved provider route and supported job format.
entries.build: Record target, input format, workspace scope and artifact identity.
entries.test: Compare an authorized simulator fixture with the local reference and verify failure or expiry reconciliation.

entries.name: IonQ
entries.upstream: IonQ API and selected provider route
entries.reuse: Reuse circuit limits, native gates and job records from one supported route.
entries.build: Normalize supported circuit features without hiding native results or uncertainty.
entries.test: Check an ideal fixture with the supported simulator and verify a bounded physical sample with stated statistical criteria.

entries.name: Quantinuum Nexus
entries.upstream: Nexus and supported compiler and emulator interfaces
entries.reuse: Reuse the selected workspace and native compilation and measurement metadata.
entries.build: Record compiler settings, circuit target and permissions.
entries.test: Use an authorized emulator to verify a small circuit and target restrictions before validating a physical run.

entries.name: Rigetti pyQuil and QCS
entries.upstream: Quil, pyQuil and provider routes
entries.reuse: Use native circuit tools and the selected simulator or service.
entries.build: Track circuit format, provider ID and target-specific restrictions and calibration when provided.
entries.test: Compare a direct simulation with the tool output, then verify compiled gates against an authorized target before submission.

entries.name: IQM Client
entries.upstream: Native circuit client and supported device routes
entries.reuse: Reuse native circuit validation and submission.
entries.build: Preserve device, calibration when available, mapping and native status.
entries.test: Verify allowed and unsupported gate/layout fixtures and compare a permitted sample with a simulator reference.

entries.name: D-Wave dimod
entries.upstream: BQM/CQM representations and exact local samplers
entries.reuse: Use model objects and local exact samplers.
entries.build: Map site IDs and coverage to variables and decode back to the original score.
entries.test: Compare every returned valid result to the exhaustive evaluator and verify conflicts, constraints and alternative optima.

entries.name: D-Wave Leap
entries.upstream: Direct QPU and hybrid samplers
entries.reuse: Use published sampler and limit interfaces.
entries.build: Keep direct quantum annealing and hybrid method IDs, embedding or constraints, limits and reported timing.
entries.test: Compare valid results and optimality gaps to an exact reference, check over-limit handling and preserve reported timings.

entries.name: Pasqal Pulser
entries.upstream: Pulse sequences, emulator and remote backends
entries.reuse: Reuse native device and sequence validation and supported emulation.
entries.build: Create a modality-specific record with array geometry, units and pulse sequence.
entries.test: Run a small documented emulator case and reject invalid geometry before execution, comparing observables to the published reference.

entries.name: QuEra via Braket AHS
entries.upstream: Braket Analog Hamiltonian Simulation
entries.reuse: Use native analog SDK and an authorized device or simulator route.
entries.build: Record atom geometry, control waveform, shots and execution target.
entries.test: Compare a small fixture with an independent emulator and verify physical execution reports sampling and device constraints.

entries.name: Quandela Perceval
entries.upstream: Optical circuits and photonic simulators
entries.reuse: Use original circuits, processors and sampling interfaces.
entries.build: Keep modes, photon input and post-selection in a photonics-specific manifest.
entries.test: Check an analytic two-mode beam-splitter example and distinguish total from post-selected events.

entries.name: OpenQASM 3
entries.upstream: Circuit language and versioned feature set
entries.reuse: Reuse the supported SDK parser or exporter.
entries.build: Track program version and supported features and errors.
entries.test: Round-trip a known circuit and compare semantics; explicitly reject unsupported constructs and register ordering conflicts.

entries.name: Quantum Intermediate Representation
entries.upstream: LLVM IR representation and profile definitions
entries.reuse: Use provider-supported compiler and profile definitions.
entries.build: Record profile and compiler version and verify advertised capabilities.
entries.test: Pass a compatible fixture and produce a clear failure for an unsupported profile.

entries.name: Mitiq
entries.upstream: Error-mitigation toolkit and frontends
entries.reuse: Reuse supported mitigation methods and preserve original measurements.
entries.build: Record variants, fitting choices, seeds and additional shots.
entries.test: Check noisy expected values against an ideal reference, comparing raw and mitigated estimates across seeds with uncertainty and overhead.

entries.name: Microsoft Quantum Resource Estimator
entries.upstream: Resource estimation with explicit architecture assumptions
entries.reuse: Reuse estimator and compatible input tooling.
entries.build: Preserve qubit and error-model assumptions, estimated units and version.
entries.test: Repeat a documented estimate and change one hardware assumption to verify both the result and its provenance.

entries.name: Polisplexity HPC simulation dispatch
entries.upstream: Versioned experiment plus HPC job and artifact manifests
entries.reuse: Reuse the simulator and the HPC adapter's lifecycle.
entries.build: Bind experiment ID, circuit hash and simulator settings to the HPC receipt and re-import results.
entries.test: Run the same small circuit locally and after HPC dispatch, compare probabilities and retain both run records.

entries.name: Qiskit Experiments
entries.upstream: Existing experiment definitions and analysis for characterization
entries.reuse: Reuse a documented characterization or tomography experiment and its analysis tools.
entries.build: Keep circuit families, run dates, shots, uncertainties and device configuration with the outcome.
entries.test: Run a synthetic calibration fixture with a known signal. Verify fitted values, uncertainty and native/MCP parity.

entries.name: Qiskit Nature
entries.upstream: Quantum chemistry and other scientific problem mapping
entries.reuse: Use native second-quantized operators and supported mappings for a specific small problem.
entries.build: Bind source problem data, basis, mapper and reference energy to an experiment recipe.
entries.test: Compare a reproducible small molecule case against classical exact diagonalization and validate energy units and symmetry assumptions.

entries.name: OpenFermion
entries.upstream: Fermionic operators and mappings to qubit operators
entries.reuse: Reuse operator construction and a supported transformation for an independent reference.
entries.build: Preserve operator ordering, basis and source data identity in an application-specific contract.
entries.test: Compare an analytically known small operator before and after mapping and reproduce its spectral reference.

entries.name: Microsoft QDK and Q#
entries.upstream: Q# programs and documented local simulators and tooling
entries.reuse: Use the QDK compiler and supported simulators for Q#-native recipes.
entries.build: Record program and compiler version, simulation target and exchange capabilities for the chosen workload.
entries.test: Run a fixed two-qubit example locally and compare the emitted measurements with the analytic distribution and a second simulator.

entries.name: MQT Bench
entries.upstream: Versioned quantum circuit benchmark generation
entries.reuse: Reuse supported circuit families and abstraction levels as compiler and simulator fixtures.
entries.build: Store benchmark name, level, program and exact settings in the experiment manifest.
entries.test: Generate a small circuit twice at a pinned version and verify source/compiled equivalence and reported circuit metrics.
